I hope anyone beating this run has more fun than I did. This run was already inconsistent enough, and the new skip I found makes it even more inconsistent. I had a 1:03 run but I wasn't recording, and I couldn't recreate a time within 2 seconds of that in 4 hours.

If you're attempting this run, probably don't use the sbr4 like I did because the suspension is made of toothpicks and tissue paper. Your best bet is probably a vivace or a scintilla.

Sub 1 minute is possible, and probably doable, if you're willing to deal with the inconsistencies of the jump. A 1:05 is pretty bad, and probably will be pretty easy to beat if I'm being honest.

Getting over the little fence at the end is the hardest part. In the submitted run I got a bit further to the easier and more consistent snow ramp, but going over by hitting the rocks closer to the finish is possible as well. Also, after the jump onto the snow, there's a little tree that flips you if you land on it.

Good luck, I hate this run lol.
